{{Quote|Bruit, you know that I'm a patient man, and basically a peaceful one. I've tolerated these acts of vandalism and sabotage, but I've reached my limit.|Jurnel Arrant, to [[Patch Bruit]]|<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur" />}}
'''Jurnel Arrant''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], serving as the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] of [[Lommite Limited]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Secretly, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] manipulated events to put Lommite Limited out of business and allow the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to take their mines.<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur" />
